name: facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/experiment_utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.create_cluster_manager: create a ClusterManager instance to handle SLURM job preemption and checkpointing for distributed training
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint to disk with optional epoch id and automatic best model tracking
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.set_checkpoint_dir: set the global checkpoint directory path for all ClusterManager instances before initialization
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.install_signal_handlers: install SIGUSR1 and SIGTERM signal handlers to manage job preemption and graceful termination
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.handle_sigusr1_signal: handle the SIGUSR1 signal by setting a flag and triggering a callback for job relaunch

facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.make_logger: create a Python logger for a given rank with configurable verbose logging to stdout
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.get_tcp_interface_name: get the active network interface name for ethernet or infiniband by querying system interfaces
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.review_make_logger: review the make_logger function to understand how it creates rank-aware loggers with stream handlers
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.review_get_tcp_interface_name: review the get_tcp_interface_name function to understand how it detects active network interfaces
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.summarize_helpers_module: summarize the helpers module utility functions for logging setup and network interface detection

facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.create_Meter_instance: create a Meter instance with a custom print tag to track benchmark timing values
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.update_Meter_values: update a Meter with new values and optional count to compute running average and standard deviation
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.reset_Meter_state: reset a Meter to clear all accumulated values including average, sum, count, and standard deviation
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.format_Meter_csv_output: format a Meter as a CSV string showing current value, average, and standard deviation or MAD
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.create_stateful_Meter: create a stateful Meter that tracks value history and computes mean absolute deviation over time
